mechanics.claim: After pulling enemies, Darius will automatically basic attack the closest pulled target, prioritizing champions, which is a separate attack-triggered damage instance.
mechanics.quote: After the pull, '''Darius''' will attempt to basic attack the closest pulled target, prioritizing enemy champions.

mechanics.claim: The armor penetration granted stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration.
mechanics.quote: The armor penetration {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other forms of [[Armor_penetration#Percentage_armor_penetration|percentage armor penetration]].

mechanics.claim: Darius is unable to move or cast Decimate or Noxian Guillotine for 0.4 seconds after Apprehend's cast time ends, delaying follow-up abilities.
mechanics.quote: ''Darius'' is unable to move or cast {{ai|Decimate|Darius}} or {{ai|Noxian Guillotine|Darius}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Apprehend's cast time.''
